experiments.name: dependent vector chain with reset helper
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.w $r5, 1; li.w $r6, 1065353216' --asm 'vfrecip.s $vr0, $vr0; vpickve2gr.w $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: vpickve2gr extracts element 0, and/or forces it back to the test value, vreplgr2vr replicates it; the vadd.b baseline is subtracted.

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.w $r5, 1; li.w $r6, 1065353216' --asm 'vadd.b $vr0, $vr0, $vr0; vpickve2gr.w $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Same helper chain with vadd.b replacing the variable-latency operation.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent. Latency range measured over 11 operand values with the element-0 reset helper. Min 10.98 at 0, max 29.00 at maxsub. Sample uses 1.

throughput.init: li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr8, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr9, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr10, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr11, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr12, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr13, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr14, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr8, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr9, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr10, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr11, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr12, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr13, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr14, $r4; li.w $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vfrecip.s $vr0, $vr8; vfrecip.s $vr1, $vr9; vfrecip.s $vr2, $vr10; vfrecip.s $vr3, $vr11; vfrecip.s $vr4, $vr12; vfrecip.s $vr5, $vr13; vfrecip.s $vr6, $vr14; vfrecip.s $vr7, $vr15'
throughput.notes: Throughput range over 11 operand values: min CPI 4.50 at 0, max CPI 13.50 at maxsub. Sample uses 1.

notes: LSX variable-latency floating-point instruction. Latency measured with a reset helper that keeps element 0 at the test value; throughput measured with 8 independent lanes. Ranges cover special values, exact/non-exact cases, subnormals, and overflow/underflow boundaries. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
